faq.q: How much does AVA Law Group charge?
faq.a: AVA Law Group publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does AVA Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. AVA Law Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does AVA Law Group have offices?
faq.a: AVA Law Group publishes two offices, in San Diego and Billings. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at AVA Law Group?
faq.a: AVA Law Group names 13 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
